appDescription.message: Chrome-native Side Panel controller for durable ChatGPT iteration workflows.

runFoundationDescription.message: Run directly against an explicitly selected ChatGPT tab using durable Repeat execution.

queueFoundationDescription.message: Ordered message queue behavior arrives in its owning roadmap step. The workspace destination is reserved now.

presetsFoundationDescription.message: Preset lifecycle behavior arrives in its owning roadmap step. Direct runs do not require a preset.

templatesFoundationDescription.message: Create and manage reusable message templates with bounded variables and revision-safe working copies.

settingsFoundationDescription.message: Settings, diagnostics, history, and data controls arrive in their owning roadmap step.

futureCapability.message: Domain behavior is intentionally deferred to its roadmap owner.

targetDescription.message: Choose the exact ChatGPT tab this run owns. Changing the browser active tab never retargets an existing run.

noChatGptTabs.message: No eligible ChatGPT tabs are currently available.

presetDeferredHelp.message: Presets are optional. Saved preset lifecycle arrives in the Presets step.

autoContinueHelp.message: Click ChatGPT Continue when a partial response exposes it.

autoScrollHelp.message: Scroll the target conversation to the bottom before sending.

noCurrentRun.message: No run has been started yet.

frozenExplanation.message: Chrome has frozen the target tab. DOM work cannot execute until Chrome unfreezes it, usually when the tab is activated.

discardedExplanation.message: Chrome discarded the target tab and unloaded its page. The run remains durable and will reconcile after the tab reloads and reconnects.

reconnectExplanation.message: The Side Panel is reconnecting to the extension runtime. The durable run continues under background authority.

failedExplanation.message: The run stopped because an execution error was persisted.

targetNotReady.message: Select a ready ChatGPT tab before starting.

invalidRunConfiguration.message: Enter a message, 1–10000 iterations, and a delay from 5–3600 seconds.

templateLibraryDescription.message: Load a saved template into a working copy. Names are labels; stable IDs remain the reference authority.

noTemplates.message: No templates have been saved yet.

templateEnabledHelp.message: Disabled templates remain saved but are not intended for execution references.

templateVariablesHelp.message: Supported variables are bounded to {iteration}, {total}, {remaining}, and {timestamp}. No scripts or expressions are evaluated.

templateDirtyGuard.message: This working copy has unsaved changes. Save As, Update, or Reset before replacing it.

templateStaleGuard.message: A newer saved revision exists. Your working copy was preserved; Reset reloads the latest saved revision.
